rubric.hand_obstruction: covered=true when a hand, arm or hand-held tool (pencil, pen, brush, stump) lies over any part of the paper / drawing surface, including a pencil tip touching the paper; a hand on the desk beside the paper is false; loose objects that are not hands, arms or tools (pencil shavings, a pencil case) do not count. hand_visible=true when any human hand or arm appears anywhere in the frame.
rubric.drawing_stage: 0 = blank page (no marks); 1 = first marks (a few lines, construction or gesture only); 2 = drawing in progress (clearly underway, substantial but unfinished); 3 = finished drawing (complete, little left to add). acceptable adds an adjacent level only when the frame genuinely sits between two levels.
rubric.best_still: Pick the frame where the drawing is most fully visible, no hand or tool in the way, sharp (not motion blurred), well lit, and representative of the finished or most advanced state. When no frame is clean, prefer the most advanced state with the least obstruction.
